main_body: Closed war drum: a tan drumskin ellipse on top of a red-orange cylindrical body with yellow studs, standing in a wooden frame
top_band: Column x=16: rows 3-12 form the drumskin ellipse (orange rim at row 3, tan L=171 at row 4, light tan L=204 at rows 5-7, mid tan at rows 8-9, darker tan at rows 10-12), closed by a dark rim line at row 13
evidence: The scan at x=16 reads a rounded, shaded drumskin ellipse about 10 rows tall. It sits above a dark rim row (13) and a red cylindrical body (rows 14-21) with a yellow stud edge at the bottom, so a top surface and a front face are both clearly drawn. The ellipse silhouette is wider than the shaft, with rounded corners and yellow studs. This matches the green barrel/ellipse-top guide. The frame legs and crossbar are secondary. The body has no doors or panels, so recessed_front is false, but a closed drum does not need them.

style.evidence: The drumskin has about 4-5 tan steps with a highlight blob, and the body has 4 red-orange steps plus yellow stud accents. The outline is a tinted dark red-brown, with 0% neutral dark edge pixels, so it is not a sticker line. Median colours per tile is 15, close to the references (17 and 20). Distinct colours (20 vs 38-40) and flat-fill coverage (15%, against 13% and 0%) are slightly weaker, but the piece is small and holds up next to the references.
